items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 7.3.5 at source lines 569-578: a homotopy h : f ~ g induces a homotopy trunc n h : trunc n f ~ trunc n g whose composite with the naturality paths is required to equal ap(|.|_n)(h(a)) up to a specified square. The statement is a coherence requirement, and the proof (source lines 579-583) has to manufacture it: the naive candidate is only a homotopy between the two composites after composing with the naturality paths (source line 581), so one must first turn it into an equality by function extensionality, then use that precomposition with |.|_n is an equivalence (source line 582) to lift that equality to a path between the functors, and finally appeal to the coherence laws for function extensionality to obtain a homotopy with exactly the required composite. Nothing of this is visible from the statement, whose content is only the square.
